d:
Welcome to another episode of my Oceania Series as I continue my journey to visit every country in the world.
This video is a little different.
After years of traveling around the world, I found myself in Brisbane, Australia, feeling completely exhausted from traveling. I was tired, homesick, and honestly just wanted to go back home. For the first time in a long time, the constant movement, new countries, airports, and uncertainty started to feel heavy.
I had a bit of a breakdown in Australia, but somehow I still managed to get myself outside and walk around Brisbane.
